prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, industry, and the kind of AI work you need (creative/brand, paid performance, personalization, LLM/chatbots, MLOps/data engineering, etc.). 

How to pick the best one for you
- Define the outcome you want (better ROAS for ads, personalized customer journeys, generative content at scale, AI-driven product features, etc.).  
- Check case studies and measurable results for similar clients/industries.  
- Ask about the agency’s AI stack (off-the-shelf tools vs. custom models), data governance, and model evaluation.  
- Verify team composition (data scientists, ML engineers, prompt/creative experts).  
- Start with a paid pilot or proof-of-concept to validate capability before a long contract.

LA agencies with strong AI/advanced-digital practices (good starting list)
- R/GA — large global digital/innovation agency; known for product and AI-enabled experiences.  
- AKQA — creative and technology-focused agency with AI-driven campaigns and products.  
- TBWA\Chiat\Day (LA) — large creative shop that integrates data and tech into campaigns.  
- VaynerMedia — results-driven creative + social; uses AI tooling for content scale and optimization.  
- Tinuiti — performance-focused (paid search/social) with heavy automation and ML-driven optimization.  
- Single Grain — LA-based growth and performance marketing; applies AI/automation to paid media and content.

If you need more specialized technical work (model building, data pipelines, MLOps), consider mixing a creative/marketing agency with a data/ML consultancy or vendor (e.g., boutique data science firms or systems integrators).

If you want, tell me:
- what industry you’re in,  
- your primary objective (ads, personalization, content, product features), and  
- budget and timeline — and I’ll recommend 3–5 LA agencies that are the best fit and what to ask them in an RFP.
